verdict.rationale: A probe confirms GitBook serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200), and an llms-full.txt is also published. First-party docs describe "LLM-ready docs", "LLM optimizations", MCP servers for published docs, and agent skills, and doc pages are reachable as .md files, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how llms.txt/llms-full.txt are generated for customer-published sites, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Write in the editor, drive it from your agent, or sync from Git.
